defects.symptom: Skipped MAIN attempts leave no V2 observation.
defects.root_cause: The ladder hook is appended only to the successful native try-body. NO ACTIVE and QUOTE WAIT continue; outer exceptions also bypass it. SQLite can be intact while runtime evidence is incomplete.
defects.exact_evidence: Native source lines 4033-4037, 4091-4101, 4319-4324; instrument() in btc15_information_native_offpath_candidate.py. Historical 04:15-13:30 UTC: 322 quote waits, 88 exact NO ACTIVE messages, 36 outer warnings; see historical_runtime_0/1/2.json. Counts are attempts, not lost records.
defects.strategy_semantic_impact: Extra UNAVAILABLE calls to Directional.process/Scalp.process could change path continuity or confirmations. They are forbidden as an accounting shortcut.
defects.smallest_correction: Add a separate administrative attempt stream with attempt ID, stage, outcome and elapsed clocks, linked to existing publication IDs. Do not call either strategy processor, rewrite historical rows or count administrative rows as qualified observations.
defects.tests_required: Inject NO ACTIVE, quote wait, target failure, rollover exception and success; reconcile attempts exactly once; unchanged processor call trace/state; queue/disk failure explicit; snapshot consistency.
defects.deployment_requirement: Both-lane schema/bridge coordination. Administrative evidence preparation is already authorized; treating it as strict coverage would require review. No deployment in this audit.
defects.offline_evidence: Skipped native attempts, exceptions, source clocks and accepted offers have separate bounded evidence. Actual worker test proves one strategy commit and three linked administrative rows.
defects.remaining_gate: Hard-kill loss of an uncommitted administrative item remains possible; no claim of lossless administrative capture.

defects.symptom: Openings start late; every new V8.1 ticker incurs an unavailable observation.
defects.root_cause: MAIN performs unopened discovery and open-list I/O before staged exact fetch; target may not yet exist. Both quote providers reset on a new ticker and return None. V8.1 immediately journals that forced warm-up as UNAVAILABLE. Canonical V8.1 discovery can also return no active market.
defects.exact_evidence: All 37 historical openings have a quote-wait log before first MAIN observation; 30 have an exception, 30 NO ACTIVE (overlap). At 15:00:06.149 target_ready=false; 09.677 ticker reset; 09.850 book usable; 15.781 quote consumed. V81 QualifiedInputs.snapshot/frame and loop lines 122-149 prove the forced first unavailable state.
defects.strategy_semantic_impact: No fabricated target, pre-open qualification, REST-price fallback, extra strategy evaluation or altered confirmation count. Prewarming can change source timing and must be reviewed explicitly.
defects.smallest_correction: Stage exact official identity and prepare the existing timestamped book before its first native consumption, subject to the same open-time/target/source checks. Stop putting optional discovery work ahead of an already verified exact handoff. First prove identical selected identity and causal inputs. Keep genuine discovery/target waits visible.
defects.tests_required: Delayed target, cached open list, no market, wrong ticker, changed target, delayed snapshot, reconnect and exact rollover. A warm-up attempt cannot be hidden or relabeled PASS to satisfy scoring.
defects.deployment_requirement: Coordinated MAIN/V8.1 runtime change. Review source-acquisition/evidence boundary first; not a frontend-only fix.
defects.offline_evidence: Same decoder/provider with exact official handoff, target/window invariants, bounded two-instance pool, no pre-open or extra native evaluation; delayed target/reset/reconnect/causality tests.
defects.remaining_gate: Live readiness is not guaranteed. A missing official target or post-open source still excludes strict scoreability.

defects.symptom: Closing-edge observations disappear or record unavailable books.
defects.root_cause: A paired executable book can genuinely become unavailable near close. MAIN skips publication on this condition; V8.1 records it. Missing executable sides are not packet-loss evidence.
defects.exact_evidence: 36/37 historical MAIN windows have closing quote-wait logs. Live 11:15 ET contract: final MAIN record 15:13:59.4357, close 15:15:00; nine final-minute waits. At 15:14:13.788, :34.093 and :54.578 logs explicitly say EMPTY SIDE | no | real snapshot retained. main_quote_close.json.
defects.strategy_semantic_impact: Inventing a complementary/last price, accepting an empty side or enlarging the 6s budget changes eligibility/source definition.
defects.smallest_correction: Represent NO_EXECUTABLE_PAIRED_BOOK as a real source condition; retain actual evidence and immediately suppress actionable prices. Account for the attempt administratively. Do not promise to make an externally empty book executable.
defects.tests_required: One empty side, stale timestamps, noncontiguous sequence, reconnect and close; no guidance or later-bid fabrication; strict cohort remains excluded when required inputs are unavailable.
defects.deployment_requirement: Journaling/presentation package; no provider substitution. Any altered scoring treatment requires evidence-definition approval.
defects.offline_evidence: Empty paired book removes prices and actions; native attempt is accounted without synthetic strategy frames. Original empty/sequence/stale gates retained.
defects.remaining_gate: External executable-book unavailability cannot be corrected by this implementation.

defects.symptom: 49 historical internal gaps are slow post-input processing, not logged waits.
defects.severity: P1 confirmed stage; inner operation unresolved
defects.root_cause: A native decision has already acquired fresh BRTI, but completion and ladder publication occur much later. The critical path includes fair-frame/model work, native shadow lifecycle work, information anchor copying and synchronous cohort fsync before the ladder hook. Existing logs do not time these individually.
defects.exact_evidence: Of 54 >15s gaps, five overlap quote waits; all remaining 49 contain one fresh-at-cutoff BRTI decision followed by BTC_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE at the next journal publication. Cutoff-to-publication delay 9.322-24.470s, median 15.168s. Largest: 11:53:35.084234 cutoff to 11:53:59.554070 publication. slow_gap_stages.json / max_gap_logs.json.
defects.dependency: D01, D05, D18; retained model-input witnesses
defects.strategy_semantic_impact: Changing cutoff, using processing time as source time, moving the strategy hook earlier, or parallelizing strategy state can change semantics. A particular function or CPU/I/O cause is not yet proven.
defects.smallest_correction: Add bounded stage timing around the existing operations, with no new native evaluations. Optimize only the measured non-strategy bottleneck; require exact feature-vector/model-output and state-trace equivalence. Do not deploy a speculative model, fsync or scheduler rewrite.
defects.tests_required: Representative slow-frame replay/profile; feature bytes/probabilities unchanged; processor order/count unchanged; causal source ages rechecked at real publication; native cadence and commit-latency distributions before/after.
defects.deployment_requirement: Release-blocking measurement. Pure administrative timing is already authorized; a specific performance patch cannot honestly be finalized until the blocking operation is measured.
defects.offline_evidence: 40-stage-sample benchmark and 10 complete loops with original legacy shadow model; 48.226-59.950 ms locally. Stage evidence added.
defects.remaining_gate: Production 9.322-24.470-second delays were not reproduced. Inner cause unresolved; no scheduler/model/fsync/thread optimization selected.

defects.symptom: Fresh action snapshots expire between MAIN publications.
defects.root_cause: MAIN nominal evaluation interval is 5s while BRTI is already aged when sampled. The action expires at min(close, BRTI+5, BTC+10, quote+6, capture+15). Faster GETs cannot renew that evidence. Network time further reduces usable display life.
defects.exact_evidence: 15:00-15:16 UTC: 187 attempts, median separation 5.020s, max 7.095s; 172 completed decision logs, 14 quote waits, one target exception. For the complete 11:15 ET window: 161 decisions, median separation 5.602s, max 12.754s; median BRTI age at cutoff 2.178s. 24 later MAIN GETs returned 11 PASS / 13 SOURCE_EXPIRED.
defects.strategy_semantic_impact: Do not expand freshness, renew expiry on GET, retain expired action text as live, or feed faster information frames to action processors.
defects.smallest_correction: Use one stable card layout with explicit CURRENT / EXPIRED / UNAVAILABLE state, historical origin clearly marked, and immediate action withdrawal. Repair measured publication overhead. Keep current source context and authoritative decision state visibly distinct.
defects.tests_required: Advance real/monotonic clocks past every deadline; repeated cached replies never extend life; delay/reorder transport; expire without a new response; no DOM ownership flash.
defects.deployment_requirement: MAIN presentation/runtime package after audit; sustained visually fresh action state cannot be guaranteed at the frozen action cadence.
defects.offline_evidence: Typed expiry withdraws guidance; stable DOM structure and changed-value writes; source budgets unchanged. Cached responses cannot renew leases.
defects.remaining_gate: Native five-second clock can still outrun remaining BRTI lifetime. Continuous actionable display is not promised.

defects.symptom: Competing legacy and V2 writers flash the same action cards.
defects.root_cause: Installer removes the inline V8.1 script but retains legacy applyState, markUnavailable and the one-second countdown. They write FINAL/EARLY/SCALP IDs also written every 250ms by V2. Calling V2 at the end of successful applyState does not retire legacy ownership.
defects.exact_evidence: btc15_information_install_v1.py assemble(); generated main_dashboard.html lines 1068-1111, 1175-1276; btc15_ladder_panel_v1.js render(). Live inspection retained legacy Watching UP Entry and SCALP UP titles alongside V2 UNAVAILABLE.
defects.strategy_semantic_impact: Implementation-only when V2 continues to render the same committed decisions and expiry. No state processor changes.
defects.smallest_correction: Define an explicit set of V2-owned DOM IDs and remove all legacy writes to that set, including failure/countdown/resume paths. Keep independent chart/timer/market context in separate owned regions.
defects.tests_required: Run the complete assembled page, both scripts and timers; assert one writer per action element through success, expiry, network error, rollover and resume. Existing single-script mock is insufficient.
defects.deployment_requirement: MAIN coordinated UI build only; no piecemeal production edit.
defects.offline_evidence: All legacy scripts execute; zero legacy writes to owned action fields across success, failure, timers and lifecycle in the assembled DOM test.
defects.remaining_gate: Rendered browser and physical Safari validation remain pending.

defects.symptom: Specific unavailable reasons and historical origins are discarded by the panel.
defects.root_cause: SOURCE_EXPIRED responses omit candidate, served_ts and expires_at. Recorded rejected frames often have no expiry. The panel requires these fields for all responses, throws UNQUALIFIED, clears cache and renders generic waiting text. The server intended to retain historical origin on expiry.
defects.exact_evidence: btc15_ladder_journal_v1.py view(); panel poll() validation. Live /ladders returned SOURCE_EXPIRED while the card said Waiting for fresh native evidence. bounded_product_samples.json contains 13 such MAIN envelopes.
defects.strategy_semantic_impact: Transport schema only. An unavailable envelope must never become actionable or extend an old deadline.
defects.smallest_correction: Separate validated actionable and unavailable envelope types. Preserve safe reason, lane/contract identity and clearly historical origin; sanitize all action fields. Do not attach a fresh expiry to stale evidence.
defects.tests_required: SOURCE_EXPIRED, source rejection, journal failure, malformed identity and timeout; no action revival; origin visible only as historical and only for exact contract.
defects.deployment_requirement: Shared route/view and UI change; version the public envelope. Review any downstream evidence-contract implications.
defects.offline_evidence: Typed AVAILABLE/UNAVAILABLE validation; safe reason and identity-only historical context retained; malformed payload fails closed.
defects.remaining_gate: Historical origin is never current entry permission.

defects.symptom: Fresh SCALP guidance is hidden when MAIN expires.
defects.root_cause: aligned requires qualified MAIN before it will show a qualified V8.1 record. MAIN action freshness is being used as a prerequisite for another independently qualified lane. It is not a SCALP strategy gate.
defects.exact_evidence: panel render(): const aligned=qualified&&s&&...; exact ticker, target, open and close comparisons follow. V81 live sampled 22 PASS vs MAIN 11 PASS out of 24 requests; these are bounded samples, not uptime percentages.
defects.strategy_semantic_impact: Removing the presentation dependency must not remove identity alignment or manufacture SCALP qualification. No change to Scalp.process.
defects.smallest_correction: Validate SCALP against its own committed source deadline and the exact current official identity. Retain immutable MAIN identity as identity metadata only, with close/rollover invalidation; otherwise show identity unverified.
defects.tests_required: MAIN expired + SCALP fresh; reversed case; mismatched target/ticker/window; rollover with delayed lane; no stale cross-lane action.
defects.deployment_requirement: Coordinated UI/identity-envelope implementation, not strategy modification.
defects.offline_evidence: SCALP validates its own source deadline against exact current official identity even when MAIN action expires. Wrong target and rollover rejected.
defects.remaining_gate: No SCALP strategy gate changed; requires verified identity and actual lane freshness.

defects.symptom: Probability dominates PASS; stale direction text and obsolete production label persist.
defects.root_cause: Large side/confidence typography is reused for unavailable output. Unavailable rendering omits titles/arrows and context cleanup. Legacy sets DIAGNOSTIC V13.2-P1. The raw model estimate is visually stronger than FINAL qualification.
defects.exact_evidence: Live desktop 15:20:04 UTC: oversized green UNAVAILABLE clipped in FINAL, upward arrow retained; EARLY Watching UP Entry and SCALP UP despite unavailable; old diagnostic label. Generated markup and panel FINAL branch show confidence rendered even when ready=false/lock_state=UNLOCKED.
defects.strategy_semantic_impact: Presentation only; independent FINAL probability and qualification remain separate. Never change final.ready based on styling.
defects.smallest_correction: Make UNLOCKED / PASS (or qualified call) the dominant FINAL heading; probability secondary and explicitly model-only. Neutralize stale arrows/titles, reset all owned text, remove obsolete diagnostic version labeling, label Kalshi values in cents as ASK/BID.
defects.tests_required: Qualified and unqualified high-probability cases; unavailable long reason; UP/DOWN transitions; narrow portrait widths; no clipping; accessible semantic status.
defects.offline_evidence: FINAL PASS/UNLOCKED is dominant, raw model probability secondary, stale labels/arrows cleared, obsolete production diagnostic label removed.
defects.remaining_gate: Visual typography and mobile overflow require rendered inspection.

defects.symptom: Mobile hide/resume and Safari behavior are not accepted end-to-end.
defects.root_cause: Both page scripts own lifecycle invalidation. V2 uses busy flags, generation tokens and AbortSignal.timeout; pending requests across suspension need explicit cancellation/reset. Existing test covers only the isolated panel in a mock DOM, not the assembled page or Safari.
defects.exact_evidence: test_btc15_ladder_ui_v2.cjs; panel visibilitychange/pagehide/pageshow; legacy invalidateView()/refresh(). This audit used cloud Chrome; no physical iPhone/iPad or Safari session was available.
defects.strategy_semantic_impact: No clock or source-budget relaxation. Browser recovery must fetch current evidence before showing guidance.
defects.smallest_correction: Centralize action-card lifecycle; cancel outstanding fetches on hide, reject previous-generation replies, clear stale caches, require current identity on resume. Use explicit abort-controller timeout fallback if required by supported Safari versions.
defects.tests_required: Actual iPhone/iPad Safari portrait/landscape, app switch/lock, hidden across close, bfcache return, network loss/recovery. Check immediate suppression and current-only repaint. Synthetic tests are supplementary.
defects.deployment_requirement: UI build plus physical-device acceptance. Cannot label Safari PASS from this environment.
defects.offline_evidence: AbortController timeout fallback, generation tokens, hide/resume, bfcache, cached expiry and rollover tests pass with full assembled scripts.
defects.remaining_gate: Browser security policy blocked local HTTP and file preview. JSDOM is not a layout engine or Safari; physical iPhone/iPad pending.

defects.symptom: Reported 2-3 cent quote lag has no exact DOM-to-book measurement.
defects.severity: P1 measurement gap with confirmed cadence mechanism
defects.root_cause: Displayed UP/DOWN asks use the native snapshot and approximately 5s legacy refresh; their DOM lacks the accepted quote timestamp/sequence. The information route already exposes timestamped same-provider quotes, but the browser comparison is not paired atomically to the latest accepted book.
defects.exact_evidence: Generated HTML applyState uses upAsk/downAsk; refresh schedules 5000ms. Existing /information sample at 15:25:57.185 served quote source 15:25:56.662, UP ask29c / DOWN ask72c. No simultaneous DOM source timestamp exists; later DOM samples cannot establish price lag. Internal parity deltas marked UNVERIFIED are not this comparison.
defects.strategy_semantic_impact: Use current executable book only for price presentation. Never substitute it into native model inputs, EARLY/FINAL/SCALP evaluation or entry provenance.
defects.smallest_correction: Publish a small atomic quote projection from the existing accepted provider, preserving ticker/target/window, epoch/sequence, exchange/accepted/published times and four prices. Render independently of action evaluation. Add render receipt telemetry so comparable tuples can be measured; keep 6s expiry.
defects.tests_required: Compute quote-source age at render, accepted-to-published and published-to-render delay, and UP/DOWN cent deltas against latest accepted comparable book. Reject wrong ticker/epoch, old responses, empty/stale sides and rollover. Report sample bounds and clock uncertainty.
defects.deployment_requirement: MAIN bounded same-provider quote projection + UI is implementation scope. Any replacement source or changed acceptance rule requires review. Exact lag/delta remains UNMEASURED, not zero.
defects.offline_evidence: Same accepted tuple projects four prices and source clocks; 500-ms presentation polling; bounded DOM receipts. Injected comparable 3-cent move reaches DOM with zero post-render delta.
defects.remaining_gate: Exact live 2-3-cent lag attribution and display latency require timestamped comparable production tuples; no invented production measurement.

defects.symptom: Strict scoreability is permanently vetoed by any recorded unavailable state.
defects.root_cause: Journal missing is sticky after any unavailable_reason. Bridge independently excludes unavailable intervals and ANDs both lanes. V8.1 forced ticker bootstrap (D02) therefore excludes every newly observed complete contract under the frozen implementation. Administrative attempt records alone cannot create a strict scoreable contract.
defects.exact_evidence: Journal.coverage lines 61-91; bridge classify_lane and score; QualifiedInputs.frame plus V81 loop. Original checkpoint: 41 slots, 38 settled both, 0 strict. Prior diagnostic patch preserves strict fields/counts; it does not cure this veto.
defects.strategy_semantic_impact: Relabeling unavailable as PASS/complete, ignoring it in the strict cohort, changing edge windows, or using administrative evidence to certify decision/path coverage changes evidence definition.
defects.smallest_correction: Keep strict production cohort unchanged. Add separate recording coverage, source availability, settlement and observed-outcome diagnostics using the existing bridge. Fix avoidable bootstrap before attempting a strict contract; do not hide natural source failures. Any additional evidence-complete reporting label must be explicitly approved and must not mean strict performance qualification.
defects.tests_required: Original 11 bridge tests + six diagnostic tests; golden historical strict counts unchanged; forced warm-up exclusion test; administrative evidence cannot increase strict count; finalized settlement and actual later-bid requirements unchanged.
defects.deployment_requirement: OFFLINE bridge reporting plus coordinated runtime dependencies. Explicit evidence-definition review gate; no new competing scorer.
defects.offline_evidence: Original strict functions are AST-identical; established scorer byte-identical. Descriptive recording/source axes remain separate. Fixture 1 then 2 strict contracts uses original processors and bridge.
defects.remaining_gate: Any natural unavailable record still excludes strict cohort. Fixtures never count as live performance.

defects.symptom: A corrected deployment cannot simply reuse the frozen scorer identity or mixed journal.
defects.root_cause: Runtime startup verifies frozen file hashes. Bridge allowlists exact builds/deployments/volumes and rejects old-build event rows. Replacing build constants while retaining old events in the same volume would fail or tempt silent cohort mixing. Process restart also resets continuity and can preserve historical origin.
defects.exact_evidence: BTC15_LADDER_COMPLETION_FREEZE_20261003.json and freeze_verifier.py; bridge IDENTITIES lines 31-40 and OLD_PRODUCTION_BUILD lines 203/205. Frozen MAIN/V81 control-plane receipts still match; 19 inspected freeze-listed MAIN files match SHA256 exactly.
defects.dependency: All release changes; D12, D15, D17
defects.strategy_semantic_impact: Strategy identity stays frozen; new product/evidence revision must be separate. Never overwrite freeze checks to bypass review or discard existing journals.
defects.smallest_correction: Version a coordinated implementation manifest and approved deployment receipt. Preserve old evidence; explicitly partition new cohort boundaries/journal epochs in the existing bridge while retaining every exclusion for each cohort. Keep model/gate/policy hashes pinned and reject unknown builds.
defects.tests_required: Old/new mixed volume, restart within contract, wrong deployment/volume, absent receipts, rollback, startup exclusion, history preservation, later-contract accumulation.
defects.deployment_requirement: Requires reviewed new hashes, actual deployment IDs, cohort rule and snapshot plan before promotion. No deployed revision prepared yet.
defects.offline_evidence: Exact manifest/build/service/volume binding, new deployment root, immutable metadata and runtime epochs, excluded startup/restart slots, foreign root byte-preservation and mixed-build rejection tests.
defects.remaining_gate: Actual production receipt cannot exist before approved deployment; runtime self-report does not authorize production scoring.

defects.symptom: Pending settlement and absent-lane tails are obscured by partial status.
defects.root_cause: Partial takes precedence over pending in the headline. Snapshots were taken at different times. Settlement reader correctly requires finalized binary official results and retries unresolved receipts after 300s on a 30s cycle.
defects.exact_evidence: Original 38 joint settlements all link. Later MAIN snapshot lacks two slots. New 11:15 ET window: MAIN authoritative at 15:15:25; V81 coverage fetched near 15:20 retained a 15:15:08 determined receipt. This is pending retry, not proof of failed linkage.
defects.strategy_semantic_impact: Do not accept determined as finalized, borrow a lane receipt, or alter settlement authority.
defects.smallest_correction: Report settlement state independently of observation/source state; distinguish NOT_IN_SNAPSHOT from census corruption. Wait for finalized receipt using existing workflow.
defects.tests_required: Asynchronous pair, nonbinary/determined receipt, eventual finalized retry, exact ticker/target/window/result mismatch rejection.
defects.deployment_requirement: Offline diagnostic bridge update; runtime retry policy need not change.
defects.offline_evidence: Settlement state and absent-lane snapshot tails reported independently of partial source/observation state; original official finalized-only linkage preserved.
defects.remaining_gate: No receipt or finalization speed is fabricated; pending remains pending.

defects.symptom: Existing alert tasks use an older first-read handoff; delivery is unproven.
defects.root_cause: Both enabled tasks point first to ops/btc15-v2-qualification-20261003, while the verified live scoring handoff is ops/v2-score at 61b3b4d. Task enablement and last execution do not prove user push/email receipt.
defects.exact_evidence: Existing IDs: daily 6a9a3752ab6c8191a728578348df6984; integrity 6aa3fd90bebc81918d82ff88676fd928. Both prompts preserve frozen builds/no orders; last_run_time 12:42:20 and 15:06:05 UTC respectively. existing_v2_automations.json. Old forward-acceptance task is disabled.
defects.strategy_semantic_impact: No new incident thresholds, duplicate watchers, automatic fixes or strategy actions.
defects.smallest_correction: After correction, update these same two tasks to the reviewed handoff/build/cohort/scorer paths and known incident ledger. Run one clearly labeled delivery test through the existing path, verify destination/settings and obtain Eric receipt.
defects.tests_required: New incident, unchanged known issue suppressed, recovery, scorer unavailable, duplicate suppressed, actual user receipt. A local outbox or last_run timestamp alone is insufficient.
defects.deployment_requirement: Post-correction operations update, no additional watcher/service. No delivery sent during audit.
defects.offline_evidence: Draft updates preserve the two existing task IDs, schedules, rules and suppression. Prior prompts retained as evidence. No task mutation/delivery performed.
defects.remaining_gate: After approval and actual correction, verify settings/destination and obtain Eric receipt from one labeled existing-path test.

defects.symptom: Broad service inventory and error noise are unresolved dependencies, not cleanup permission.
defects.root_cause: The environment contains many research/legacy processes. Native decision-path work and high dashboard read traffic coexist. Resource summaries and broken pipes alone do not identify a guilty service or justify retirement.
defects.exact_evidence: Inventory: 53 services marked live; latest deployment states 46 SUCCESS, six CRASHED, one FAILED. MAIN six-hour CPU avg2.873/max13.421 against reported24; memory current2.734GB; disk metric6.402GB (not a verified mounted-volume free-space reading). 11:53:35-54:00 logs include repeated dashboard reads and native-export BrokenPipeError. Shared owner heartbeat remained PRIMARY_OK; cumulative errors rose76 to80, 429 stayed0.
defects.dependency: D04, D15, D17; shared BRTI owner and mounted journals
defects.strategy_semantic_impact: No owner replacement, source substitution, service retirement or speculative resource/worker changes.
defects.smallest_correction: Retain inventory and map each consumer/source/durable-evidence dependency before any cleanup. Treat native-export client disconnects as bounded diagnostic events; investigate actual latency before changing concurrency. No spending/savings claim from CPU metrics.
defects.tests_required: Dependency ownership, read volumes, source request budget, mounted free space and writer health. Correlate stage timing before attributing native stalls to CPU/I/O/read traffic.
defects.deployment_requirement: Diagnostic only; no services retired, restarted or scaled.
defects.offline_evidence: No services retired, no paid resources created, no cost/savings assertion. Native client disconnect handled as bounded handler return.
defects.remaining_gate: Resource contention and dependency inventory do not establish a guilty service.

defects.symptom: Retention and observation/commit health need distinct accounting.
defects.root_cause: Retention is 30 days OR 300,000 events, whichever is reached first. At ~1 V81 event/s the count cap is about 3.47 days before admin/settlement overhead. HTTP coverage exposes only 96 contracts. Commit counters do not count skipped native attempts.
defects.exact_evidence: Journal MAX_RECORDS=300000; coverage_view limit96. Original receipts have uninterrupted committed sequence ranges. Current bounded available samples: both lanes drops=0, queue_depth=0, retained_from_sequence=1. This neither proves all attempts nor certifies future retention.
defects.strategy_semantic_impact: Administrative events must not reduce scored evidence retention silently or become decision observations.
defects.smallest_correction: Expose actual retained range and effective cap; keep administrative accounting separate/bounded; schedule detached snapshots through the existing workflow before the earlier cap. Verify disk/commit health and paired cutoffs without mutating live SQLite.
defects.tests_required: Count/time retention boundaries, queue overflow, writer failure, consistent read-only backup, SHA/integrity/sequence verification, coverage vs full-history distinction.
defects.deployment_requirement: Coordinated journaling/operations changes; preserve existing evidence. No journal loss demonstrated.
defects.candidate_files: admin.py; existing journal/bridge metadata; release review
defects.offline_evidence: Scored retention unchanged; retained sequences in existing snapshots; separate bounded admin health/range/bytes. Read-only consistent snapshot and same workflow in fixtures.
defects.remaining_gate: 30 days OR 300000 scored events; approximately 3.47 days at 1 Hz. Admin cap can be earlier. 96-contract coverage is not full history; live retention check pending.

defects.symptom: Source rejection labels are too coarse to assign every failure to the external source.
defects.root_cause: BRTI_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE and BTC_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE combine readiness/causal-age conditions. Some source-valid decisions age during processing (D04). Quote availability also conflates empty side, stale time, sequence state and bootstrap. No evidence supports a general packet-loss claim.
defects.exact_evidence: Original checkpoint reasons: MAIN BRTI139/BTC149/quote56; V81 timestamped quotes1233/official market1072/read failure3/BTC5. New 49 delayed records all label BTC_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE despite fresh BRTI at cutoff. SOURCE_READ_FAILED does not identify an upstream outage.
defects.strategy_semantic_impact: Diagnostic subreasons cannot alter gate order, source acceptance or thresholds.
defects.smallest_correction: Record separate source, received, cutoff, captured, processed, committed and served clocks with the original rejection plus a non-authoritative subreason. Retain exact source identity and do not replace missing clocks with receipt time.
defects.tests_required: Age, future-source, owner epoch, timestamp mismatch, book sides, quote sequence and model-support failures; diagnostics leave pass/fail and state trace unchanged.
defects.deployment_requirement: Additive administrative diagnostics may be prepared under the existing authorization. Raw historical reasons and qualification meaning remain unchanged.
defects.offline_evidence: Separate source/received/cut/capture/processing/commit/serve clocks, known safe rejection subreasons and expired-during-processing markers; missing clocks stay null.
defects.remaining_gate: No receipt-time substitution and no packet-loss inference; some upstream receipt clocks are not available in frozen data.

approved_scope: D02 offline source/bootstrap preparation and D13 new product/evidence revision; no strategy or strict-evidence relaxation
